//: Blocks the writing UI can insert. Add entries here to teach the editor a new container; nothing else needs changing. Templates support {{field}} with optional filters: |html, |slug, |paragraphs, |quoted, |indent. {{cursor}} marks where the caret lands after insertion.

containers.label: Info callout
containers.hint: The blue aside used for repost notices and asides, styled by .info-callout in global.css.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.placeholder: This was originally published on a different site.

fields.name: body
fields.label: Body
fields.placeholder: One or more paragraphs. Blank lines start a new paragraph.

containers.label: Quotation with citation
containers.hint: figure + blockquote + figcaption, with curly quotes, as used for quoted sources.

fields.name: quote
fields.label: Quotation
fields.placeholder: The quoted text, without quotation marks.

fields.name: note
fields.label: Trailing note
fields.placeholder: response to the 2023 Request for Input (RFI)

containers.label: Image with caption
containers.hint: figure + img + figcaption. Put the file in public/image/ and reference it as /image/name.png.

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Alt text
fields.placeholder: What the image shows, for screen readers.

fields.name: caption
fields.label: Caption
fields.placeholder: Optional caption shown under the image.

snippets.label: Code block
snippets.hint: Fenced code, highlighted by Astro’s built-in Shiki.

snippets.label: Section break
snippets.hint: The horizontal rule used between major sections.

snippets.label: Reference link
snippets.hint: Inserts [text][label] here and the [label]: url definition at the end of the post.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Reference label
fields.placeholder: Defaults to a slug of the link text.

snippets.label: Blockquote
snippets.hint: A Markdown blockquote; every line is prefixed with "> ".
